body.message:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Unfortunately, the apartment shown in the photos you shared is not available at the moment. Due to an system glitch, those images were displayed incorrectly.

Please be assured that the apartment allocated to your reservation is the one that was confirmed at the time of your booking. We truly regret any confusion or disappointment this may have caused and appreciate your kind understanding.

If you have any questions or need any further assistance, please don't hesitate to let us know. We are here to help and will do our very best to ensure you have a comfortable stay
